# Toolkit Readiness Atlas: 100 apps (2026-11-23)

## Findings
- 19/100 are not yet Composio toolkits, and only 5 of them can be built today. Checked live against composio.dev/toolkits: 81 of 100 already exist. Of the 19 gaps, 5 are build-now (LiveAgent, Vonage, systeme.io, SE Ranking, Reducto), 5 buildable with caveats, 8 need outreach and 1 is a CLI wrap. The remaining work is mostly partnerships, not engineering.
- 70/100 are self-serve. 48 give free credentials (free plan, dev account, sandbox or open source) and 22 a trial or credits. 58 can be built today with no human gate.
- 74 vs 65 apps take a static key or Basic auth vs OAuth2. 44 offer both, 30 are key-only and 21 OAuth-only. A toolkit factory needs both schemes first-class; key-only apps are the fastest builds.
- 20/20 Developer and Productivity apps are ready; Finance is the hard category. Finance has 1 ready app and 5 needing outreach (customer-only spend platforms, enterprise data, merchant gateways). Marketing and Ecommerce are mostly buildable with caveats.
- 3 × 11 blockers tie for most common. App review / platform policy, paid plan needed for credentials and customer, enterprise or vetted-partner only each block 11 apps, and cluster by category: review hits big consumer platforms, paid plans hit AI-native and SEO tools, customer-only hits fintech and enterprise data.
- 56/100 already run an official MCP server. 32 were confirmed by a page read this run; the rest are queued pass-1 claims. 3 vendor MCPs (Twilio, BigCommerce, Vonage) only search docs. AI-native apps are MCP-first (9/10): Otter's MCP works on any plan while its REST API is Enterprise-only.
- 90.3% → 100.0% field accuracy, closed-book draft → verified holdout. Half the closed-book misses (6/12) were the MCP field. The agent's confidence was calibrated: 68% of low-confidence rows needed a fix vs 6% of high-confidence ones, so research is routed by confidence.
